title: A buy that has landed, or can still land, can end up with no trades row, a trades row flipped to failed, or no exit and anti-rug monitoring, because one catch treats every error after submission as a clean zero-spend failure

evidence.note: V2: one try wraps submitBuyTx AND all post-submit bookkeeping (pause read, recordSnipe, insertTrade, alert, balanceOf, trade-id lookup, armPositionMonitoring)
V2 catch: emitSnipeFailClean, then updateTradeStatus.run(failed, token, chain), then alert "TX failed" — runs for ANY throw in the try, including after the buy mined
emitSnipeFailClean logs "Snipe FAILED CLEAN ... zero ETH spent, no trades row" unconditionally (:384)
V3 twin: same single try/catch shape; V3 arms monitoring inline at :1481-1507 (not through the shared helper)
V2 affordability gate sits OUTSIDE the try: a throw escapes the handler (links RC-05)
V3 affordability gate sits INSIDE the try: a throw reaches the catch, which runs updateTradeStatus(failed) for the token
updateTradeStatus = UPDATE trades SET status=? WHERE token=? AND chain=? AND status=pending — it matches ANY pending row of that token, including a concurrent handler's live position (RC-04)
multi-block fanout: after the bundle is already sent for block tb, a relay error for a later target block throws out of the submit closure
submitWithReconciliation: on an advanced nonce it reconciles only the PREVIOUS attempt's hash
per-attempt reconcile uses only the latest attempt's signed hash; an earlier attempt (same nonce, different fee, different hash) that mines reads as landed-not-ours and the helper throws
mined-but-reverted throws (gas spent, no tokens)
ceiling-hit throw: for the passthrough strategy an already-broadcast public tx can still be pending in the mempool and mine after this throw
passthrough wallet.sendTransaction: if an earlier attempt mined first, the next attempt's send can fail (nonce too low) and throw
post-mine: synchronous SQLite read (getPauseState) inside the try
post-mine: recordSnipe then insertTrade.run — a SQLite error here leaves the mined buy with no row
post-mine: awaited Telegram alert; sendCtxAlert awaits axios.post with no timeout (src/utils/notifier.ts:80), so a hung Telegram call delays balanceOf and arming
post-mine: balanceOf on a single RPC call — a throw goes to the catch, which flips the just-inserted row to failed
getResumeExitMonitorTrades: resumes only status=pending buys or exit_failed_held rows — a row flipped to failed with no exit_state is never resumed
a stale balanceOf of 0 is not rejected: computeDustThreshold(0) falls back to the 1000-wei absolute floor
partial-sell amount is computed from state.originalTokenAmount, so a 0 recorded at buy time makes partial sells size 0
trade-id lookup miss only logs "Could not find trade ID"; the row stays pending with no monitor until the next boot
startExitMonitor returns silently when the entry price query returns null: no exit monitor, row stays pending (links RC-07)
startExitMonitor: upsertExitState.run can throw; it propagates out of armPositionMonitoring before anti-rug is attempted, reaching the snipe catch, which flips the row to failed
anti-rug baseline/register failure is caught and logged only; with no lp_baseline row the position is excluded from anti-rug resume forever (INNER JOIN, see resumeAntiRugMonitoring :2032-2051)
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Post-buy setup errors mark successfully acquired positions failed
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Buy submission precedes any recoverable trade record
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Restart abandons pending buys without reconciling settlement
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Submission exceptions bypass reconciliation after a possible broadcast
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Earlier replacement hashes are discarded before their outcome is known
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): A reconciliation timeout abandons transactions that can still execute
22-28 (from sweep/TX.json C07): relay transport failure defers to reconciliation

sibling_sites_checked: V2 handleNewPairForChain (bot.ts:1087-1191) and V3 handleNewV3PoolForChain (bot.ts:1379-1516) both checked: same single try/catch, same catch body; V3 arms monitoring inline (:1481-1507), V2 via armPositionMonitoring (:413-452). The deliberate path (executeDeliberateBuy, :485-761) records and arms outside any catch (its own defect is AUD-BUY-001). Every submit strategy reachable from submitBuyTx was traced for "throws after a broadcast": flashbots fanout (flashbots.ts:303-309), shared reconcile loop (reconciliation.ts:476-497, :576-628), passthrough send (passthrough.ts:130); bloxroute.ts was traced by the TX slice (sweep/TX.json cell C07): a relay transport failure defers to reconciliation (bloxroute.ts:179-190), and after a not-landed attempt the next attempt re-signs the same nonce and only the latest hash is reconciled (reconciliation.ts:476-497, :576-603), so an earlier accepted attempt that mines reads as landed-not-ours, the same mechanism as sub_claim 3. Recorded at 22-28. Both resume queries were read (db.ts:597-604 and the lp_baseline INNER JOIN used at bot.ts:2043). The pause read, recordSnipe, insertTrade, alert, balanceOf, trade-id lookup and both arming helpers were each checked as separate throw points.
severity_rationale: Graded S1, one step below the research suggestion (S0/S1, the higher end taken as the suggestion). Rubric reason: every traced failure point needs a non-default condition (a single RPC or SQLite error after inclusion, a stale load-balanced node, a multi-block inclusion timing, a revert, or a concurrent same-token handler); none fires on the ordinary success path, so it is "plausible condition" (S1), not "no unusual condition" (S0). Within S1 it is the worst kind: in the post-mine and monitoring-setup traces the held position is never re-armed, not even by a restart (the resume queries need status pending or exit_failed_held, db.ts:597-604, and anti-rug resume needs an lp_baseline row), and the operator is told "zero ETH spent". The broad catch (bot.ts:1177-1191, V3 :1508-1516) and its "fail-clean" comments (bot.ts:345-358, :1178-1187) were traced, not taken at their word.
recommendation: Phase 24 (after a Phase 23 real-path proof of at least the balanceOf-throw and earlier-attempt-landed traces): separate "did money leave the wallet" from "did bookkeeping succeed". Once a submit may have broadcast, never run the zero-spend branch: reconcile against chain truth (token balance delta plus nonce, like the deliberate guard at bot.ts:617-662), record the row, and arm monitoring with retries; on any post-landing failure alert loudly that a position is held and unprotected. The direction (intent row before broadcast vs reconcile-on-throw, retry policy) is a behaviour decision on card BUY-02. Nothing is changed in Phase 22.

traces.scenario: Failure point 1, before submission: the affordability gate (or a call just before submit) throws
steps: V2: enforceEntryExitAffordability (bot.ts:1083) is outside the try; if it (or sendCtxAlert/broadcast inside it) throws, the rejection leaves handleNewPairForChain, which no caller awaits (bot.ts:1583, :1644) -> unhandled rejection (AUD-BUY-005)
V3: the same gate (bot.ts:1417) is inside the try; a throw runs the catch: emitSnipeFailClean + updateTradeStatus.run(failed, token, chain) (bot.ts:1513-1515)

updateTradeStatus matches every pending row of that token on that chain (db.ts:325-327); if a concurrent same-token handler (V2 pair and V3 pool for one token, AUD-BUY-004) has already landed and inserted its pending row, that live row is flipped to failed
traces.outcome: This handler spent nothing and holds nothing. trades: no row of its own, but a concurrent handler's live row can become failed. exit_state: untouched. The other handler's tokens ARE held; its in-process monitor keeps running, but after any restart the failed row is not resumed (db.ts:597-604), so the position is then stranded with no exit monitor or anti-rug.

traces.scenario: Failure point 2, after submission but before (or without) a confirmed mine: the strategy throws although a broadcast tx can still land
steps: Flashbots: the bundle is sent for block tb, then a relay error for target block tb+i throws (flashbots.ts:303-309); the bundle already sent for tb can still be included

Multi-attempt: attempt k and attempt k+1 share a nonce but differ in fee and hash; reconcile checks only the latest hash (reconciliation.ts:476-497, :576-603); if attempt k mines (multi-block targeting keeps it eligible), the latest hash has no receipt while the nonce advanced -> landed-not-ours -> throw
Passthrough: if an earlier attempt mines first, the next sendTransaction can fail with nonce-too-low and throw (passthrough.ts:130)
Reverted: the tx mined with status 0 -> throw (reconciliation.ts:592-597); gas was spent
Ceiling-hit: the helper throws after the last not-landed reconcile (reconciliation.ts:606-614) while a passthrough public tx can still be pending and mine later

Every one of these throws reaches the snipe catch (bot.ts:1177-1191 / :1508-1516): no insertTrade, updateTradeStatus finds no own row (or flips a concurrent one), and the operator is told "zero ETH spent, no trades row" (bot.ts:384)
traces.outcome: Tokens: held whenever an earlier attempt or the already-sent bundle landed, or the pending public tx mines later (not held for a revert, but gas is lost). trades: no row. exit_state: none. No exit monitor, no anti-rug, never resumed at restart (no row to resume), and isTokenSniped (any row) stays false, so dedup is broken and the same token can be bought again on a later event.

traces.scenario: Failure point 3, after mining, while persisting the trade row
steps: submitBuyTx returned the real hash, so the buy is mined (bot.ts:1100-1112)
getPauseState.get (bot.ts:1118), recordSnipe (:1125) or insertTrade.run (:1127) throws (for example SQLITE_BUSY or disk full): catch -> no row written
or the insert succeeds, the awaited alert at :1147 hangs (no axios timeout, notifier.ts:80) and delays everything after it
or balanceOf (bot.ts:1159) throws on one RPC error: catch -> updateTradeStatus flips the just-inserted row to failed, alert "TX failed"
traces.outcome: Tokens: held. trades: either no row, or a row with status failed. exit_state: none. No exit monitor and no anti-rug; the failed row is not in getResumeExitMonitorTrades (db.ts:597-604) and has no lp_baseline, so not even a restart re-arms it. The operator is told the buy failed and cost nothing.

traces.scenario: Failure point 3b, after mining: the balance read succeeds but is stale (lagging node behind a load-balanced RPC)
steps: balanceOf at bot.ts:1159 returns 0 because the node serving the call has not seen the inclusion block
nothing rejects 0: armPositionMonitoring/startExitMonitor are called with originalTokenAmount = 0
computeDustThreshold(0) uses only the 1000-wei absolute floor (exitEngine.ts:615-621); partial-sell sizes are computed from 0 (exitEngine.ts:1736)
traces.outcome: Tokens: held. trades: pending (correct). exit_state: written with original amount 0. The exit monitor runs, but partial-sell tiers sell 0 tokens and the stored denominator is wrong for the life of the position.

traces.scenario: Failure point 4, while setting up monitoring
steps: trade-id lookup misses (bot.ts:1162-1176): logs only, no monitor; row stays pending
startExitMonitor: queryPrice returns null -> returns without arming (exitEngine.ts:1869-1873); anti-rug is still attempted (bot.ts:431-451)
startExitMonitor: upsertExitState.run throws (exitEngine.ts:1891) -> propagates out of armPositionMonitoring before anti-rug -> snipe catch flips the row to failed
snapshotLpBaseline / registerAntiRugPosition throws -> caught and logged only (bot.ts:441-451); no lp_baseline row
V3 twin arms inline (bot.ts:1481-1507) with the same shape
traces.outcome: Tokens: held in every branch. Lookup miss or null price: trades pending, exit_state none, unmonitored for exit until the next boot (resume re-arms it). upsertExitState throw: trades failed, exit_state none, no exit monitor and no anti-rug, never resumed. Anti-rug failure: exit monitor runs but anti-rug is absent now and after every restart (no lp_baseline row for the INNER JOIN).

sub_claims.claim: A single balanceOf RPC error after a mined buy flips the trade row to failed and the position is never re-armed, even after restart
A SQLite error in the post-mine bookkeeping leaves a mined buy with no row, no monitor and broken dedup
An earlier same-nonce attempt that mines is reported as landed-not-ours and the snipe path records nothing
A Flashbots fanout error after the first send throws while the sent bundle can still land
The V3 catch can flip a concurrent same-token handler's live pending row to failed
A stale balanceOf of 0 is accepted as the original token amount

triage.note: Reproduced on the real path (plan 23-05): one post-mine balanceOf error flips the landed buy's row to failed, starts no exit monitor, alerts TX failed, and a restart does not resume it; an earlier same-nonce attempt landing (attempt 1 reconciled only) and a fanout refusal after the first send each leave a landed buy with no trades row. Sub-claims 3 and 4 moved candidate -> confirmed; sub-claims 2, 5 and 6 not tested here.
